research_subquestion: Does intent-conditioned LPWM encoder learning with planning-relevant object futures improve downstream PDMS beyond planning-only learning?
risk_weight: 1 + 4 exp(-min_future_distance_to_expert_ego^2 / (2*5m^2)); training labels only, mean normalized
selection: All existing 512 train and 192 development windows with observed front images; final update only; no best-dev selection or tuning
scope: Standalone front-camera LPWM encoder plus learned particle forecast and trajectory planner; official RGB decoder and latent-action dynamics excluded; not the original full LPWM algorithm
evaluation: Official NAVSIM v1 PDM on shared development metric caches, aggregate and scenario components, paired recording bootstrap, no independent test claim
